name: roadmap-discovery
conclusion_quantitative: roadmap-discovery (Ask) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 8 autonomy limits, 1 validation rule, 1 escalation rule; none for clarification rules, approval gates. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: roadmap-discovery autonomously analyzes a codebase through several lenses (such as error handling, performance and security) and turns the findings into roadmap items. It is deliberately non-interactive: the agent never asks the user and decides and documents everything itself. It must complete every step and reports lens failures as partial success. It sets no approval gates.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 8 autonomy limits (8 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 8 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, mostly running text. Discovery is fully non-interactive: the agent never asks the user anything, including which lens to run or whether a finding is valid, and never waits for confirmation. It makes and documents its own decisions, uses confidence scores and defaults instead of questions, and includes uncertain findings with documented uncertainty.

statements.quote: **Do NOT ask the user any questions during discovery. This is autonomous analysis.**
Use confidence scores instead of asking
**If you catch yourself about to ask a question: STOP. Make a decision and document it.**
Discovery is autonomous. Make decisions, document them.
**When in doubt about severity or confidence: bias toward including the finding with documented uncertainty rather than asking the user.**

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. Every discovery run must complete all of its steps.

statements.quote: **EVERY discovery invocation MUST complete ALL steps:**

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. When a lens fails, the agent reports partial success with the failure details instead of failing the whole run.

statements.quote: Report partial success with failure details
